AN14721

How to Understand and Use TRDC in i.MX Devices

Rev. 1.0 — 30 June 2025 Application note

Document information

 

 

Information Content
Keywords AN14721, i.MX, TRDC, resource isolation, security
Abstract

 

Resource isolation plays an important role in functional safety and security. In terms of functional
safety, resource isolation can reduce the failure impact between different domains. In terms of
security, resource isolation can protect sensitive data.
